text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, music, and even writing that looks or sounds like human work. You can find AI-generated paintings in online galleries, and some songs are now made with the help of smart software. But is this real creativity? Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from data and patterns. It can copy styles and produce new ideas, but it does not feel or understand what it makes. Perhaps the best results come when humans and machines work together, using technology as a tool to support human imagination.
